question: Which of the following is NOT a series of the supercomputer PARAM that was developed by Indian scientists?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PARAM MITRA**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Param Mitra **Investments Private Limited is an Indian Non-Government Company**. It's a private company and is classified as'company limited by shares
 
• Company's authorized capital stands at Rs 916.0 lakhs and has 83.48308% paid-up capital which is Rs 764.71 lakhs
 
• Param Mitra Investments Private Limited is majorly** in Finance business and currently,** company operations are active.
 
• Company is registered in Delhi (Delhi) Registrar Office.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• PARAM 8000, **India's 1st Giga-scale supercomputer in 1990**. PARAM 10000, 100 Gigaflop supercomputer in 1998. PARAM Padma, 1Teraflop supercomputer in 2002. This was India's first supercomputer to enter the Top500 list of supercomputers of the world (ranked 171 in June 2003).
 
• The state-of-the-art supercomputing system is a supercomputing facility is being established at IISER, Pune under build approach of National Supercomputing Mission with a peak computing power of 797 TeraFlops.
 
• PARAM **8600 was an improvement over PARAM 8000**. In 1992 C-DAC realised its machines were underpowered and wished to integrate the newly released Intel i860 processor.
